items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Somebody's name is Alil, maybe I'm not sure. But I don't know who taught him. [INTERVIEWEE] I'm not going to tell you no story.

ctx.x: Good musician. Come on out, come on out. They played some good bass since then. They played good bass. And give them a solo to play a nice solo. Beautiful. But I don't know who taught Zoo Robinson. And I have it in me.
Somebody's name is Alil, maybe I'm not sure. But I don't know who taught him.
I'm not going to tell you no story. No. No, it's not me telling a story. I'm trying to tell you everything and the facts about it.
